messages:
incident-bot: DETECT: sustained p99 increases and streaming connection churn on /v1/stream in US-East-1 and US-West-2. Error rate up ~2.4%. Auto-paging.

maya (oncall): I'm paged in. dashboards show a growing backlog on streaming workers, many streams timing out at client side. Any obvious culprit?

devon (eng-sre): worker queue depth rising; host-level CPU shows tight loops on the streaming hot path. Non-stream endpoints largely unaffected.

jun (runtime): replicated in load test: a recent scheduler/selection change for streaming kernels causes KV-cache contended path under many short-lived streams. Suspect throttle cascade when clients retry.

maya (oncall): mitigation options: per-region toggle to disable streaming responses (SSE/chunked) and fall back to buffered/complete responses; plus ingress shaping to smooth retry bursts. Propose canary in us-east-1 az-b first.

liam (platform): infra flag exists per-region/az; canary promoted. Also can route VIPs to dedicated pools for premium tenants.

ops-bot: Executing canary:```bash
infra-cli feature-flag set streaming_responses --scope hosted:us-east-1:az-b --value false --meta "inc-1812349999"
```

ops-bot: Canary applied to us-east-1 az-b.

harper (network): warning: if we flip streaming, client libraries may issue immediate long-poll retries. Recommend applying ingress token-bucket shaper (rate=1000rps, burst=2000) + short 5s ramp to avoid spike.

zoe (support): I'm seeing support tickets escalate about "partial transcript never completes". Will update customers if we disable streaming.

maya (oncall): devon/jun observe metrics. sam prepare CS blurb and status update. kyle, can infra ensure per-az re-enable is fast?

kyle (infra): yes, per-az toggles are sub-10s to apply and verify. We'll keep rollback playbook ready.

devon (eng-sre): canary metrics: streaming worker queue depth down ~58% on canary hosts; p95 latency down ~33% there. Good signal to promote.

ops-bot: Promoting flag to hosted:us-east-1 region:```bash
infra-cli feature-flag promote streaming_responses --scope hosted:us-east-1 --from az-b --to region
```

ops-bot: Flag disabled for hosted:us-east-1. Verification passed.

ops-bot: Applying ingress shaper for us-east-1 proxies: token-bucket rate=800rps burst=1600, warmup=5s.

sam (devex): CS blurb drafted: "We're temporarily disabling streaming responses in US-East-1 to stabilize API latency. Your requests will receive buffered completions instead. No data lost. Expected to restore within a few hours. If you rely on streaming, please increase client read timeout or switch to the complete endpoint." Ready to post with ara_cs signoff.

ara_cs: posted status: "Investigating elevated API latency; streaming responses temporarily disabled in US-East-1. Non-stream fallbacks available. Updates to follow." Reached out to top affected customers.

nina (product): ensure private/dedicated deployments are unaffected. Also track any cost delta from buffered responses.

jun (runtime): telemetry: after disable, p99 token latency for affected hosts fell near baseline in ~7 minutes; CPU hotloops reduced. KV-cache eviction events decreased.

devon (eng-sre): additionally applied scoped quota smoothing for customers showing repeated retries to avoid repeated bursts. Scaled 5 enterprise tenants by +15% for 1h.

liam (platform): routing policy updated for top-tier tenants to prefer dedicated pools where available to reduce impact.

maya (oncall): monitoring scheduled: metric-check every 60s for next 3h. If p95 stays < target and error rate stable, we'll keep mitigation and focus on a staged revert for the kernel change. devon will take handoff.

devon (eng-sre): taking pager. immediate next steps: revert kernel-scheduler tweak in staging, run high-concurrency stream load, validate KV-cache interactions, then plan canary redeploy.

kyle (infra): adding runbook action: make streaming flag per-az default for quicker rollback; add a circuit-breaker that disables streaming on individual hosts when queue_depth > threshold and CPU signature matches hotloop pattern.

harper (network): monitoring ingress shaper effects: tail drop reduced, spikes smoothed. No proxy CPU issues.

zoe (support): posting templated message to customers and opening quick calls with two biggest accounts. They requested ETA; short answer: "we expect to restore within a few hours pending staging validation."

sam (devex): saving SDK snippet and SDK config toggles to incident ticket to help customers toggle streaming off client-side if needed.

ops-bot: health-check job scheduled: run every 30s for 180 minutes, alert on p95 or error-rate regressions.

incident-bot: Incident created: inc-1812349999. Severity: sev2. Postmortem doc template: https://redwood-internal/pmo/incidents/1812349999

nina (product): assign postmortem owners: jun (runtime) and devon (eng-sre). devex (sam) to draft customer impact. platform (liam) to update runbooks.

devon (eng-sre): 45m update: metrics stable, error-rate back to baseline. scheduling kernel revert test in staging.

maya (oncall): handoff: devon will monitor incident until revert validated; I'm staying on as incident lead for exec comms. Closing active page. Keep thread updated with any customer escalations. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Monitoring window complete: no threshold breaches in 3h.

devon (eng-sre): post-incident plan: - revert change in staging and run load test - add host-level auto-disable circuit-breaker - instrument KV-cache lock contention more deeply - schedule postmortem.

sam (devex): CS follow-ups sent. customers acknowledged mitigation and appreciated quick response.

nina (product): ensure we measure latency/cost delta when streaming is re-enabled to validate no regressions in unit economics.

maya (oncall): final summary for status/exec: "Streaming responses were temporarily disabled in US-East-1 to mitigate increased tail latency caused by a runtime scheduler regression affecting KV-cache path. Non-stream fallbacks remained available; region stabilized. Revert under test; postmortem and customer report to follow."

ara_cs: thanks, coordinating remaining outreach.

ops-bot: closing thread. Follow-ups tracked in incident ticket inc-1812349999.
